known_gaps: no RenderPort / visual capture (render engines are not dependencies; capability stays NOT_PROVEN)
no idempotency keys, grant/commit/job ports: the session runs standalone
edit sequence stops at the first failing edit; no multi-edit atomic batch
artboard and page-spread renames supported by chronicle but not exposed by the harness commands
stories and sequences are summarized but not editable
--save has no root restriction by design: the caller owns the destination (documented in the manual); only replacing the input needs --overwrite
hard links to the input are not detected by the --save guard (symlinks and path spellings are, via canonicalize)
